bio: Häana is a Los Angeles-based producer and composer who merges classical string virtuosity with downtempo bass, cinematic textures, and nature-field recordings, citing Massive Attack, Björk, and RY X as influences on her 'future-ethereal' sound. She performs live with reactive visuals, dance, and immersive electronics.
notable_releases: Art On Fire Soundtrack, Ornate EP, Brym Remix Album; tracks including "Ghost Ranch," "Jóga," "Flower Moon," "Snow," "Dritvík"

bio: Ladybeats is a San Francisco-based DJ known for a melodic techno and tech house sound, built in part through her recurring 'disco forest' mix series. She played a b2b set with Tagg at DeMentha on Thursday of Burning Man 2025, released as a roughly 57-minute mix.
burning_man_history: Played a live b2b set with Tagg at DeMentha, Thursday, Burning Man 2025 (mix released on SoundCloud, ~57 min, 17 tracks, featuring selections referencing Eric Prydz, Billie Eilish, Eelke Kleijn, and MEDUZA).

bio: Santiago Garcia is an Argentine DJ/producer, born and raised in Buenos Aires and now based in Ibiza, with over 20 years in the music industry spanning deep house, melodic techno, and Afro-indie-influenced sound. He received a 'Best Producer from Argentina' nomination from DJ Mag and has earned support from Solomun, Keinemusik, Tale Of Us, Black Coffee, Âme, and Dixon.
notable_releases: An Be Se (2026 album), Signature (2024 album), Bay of Skaill (2020 album); singles "What's Wrong?" (2025), "Santa" (2025), "into flames" (2026)
labels: Innervisions, Renaissance, Exit Strategy, Get Physical, Armada, Moblack, plus his own imprint Signature Music
notable_collaborations: Black Coffee (Best of Ibiza 2017 compilation), Blond:ish, Bedouin

bio: Rezonance is a Swedish act releasing alternative/trip-hop/electro music via Bandcamp, with production support from Stockholm's SoundBitz studio and artwork by Patrik Lark.
notable_releases: Lynx (2013 EP), Velvet (Dec 2012), Black Filters – The Singles Live! (Aug 2012), Obscurity (May 2012)

bio: KRAKADILLA is a Los Angeles-based electronic/techno producer whose work blends organic and synthetic textures, built around a recurring conceptual theme of primal, reptilian imagery.
notable_releases: Dragon's Cave (Static) (2024 album), Under Tech, Vol. 1 (2024 EP); singles "Rhombus" (2024), "Proper Roll" (2024), "Corrosion" (2025), "Deep Waters" (2026)

bio: Jkali is a producer/remixer in the global bass and bass house space who has worked with global-bass genre pioneer David Starfire, contributing a remix of "Serpentine" (feat. Mah Ze Tar) to David Starfire's Multiverse Remixes Vol. 3 EP.
notable_releases: "Serpentine (Jkali Remix)" on Multiverse Remixes Vol. 3 (released Jan 9, 2025)

bio: Seth Finkin is a San Francisco-based DJ and curator working 'in the emotional space between disco and techno,' drawing on a background as a drummer to build rhythm-driven, narrative-focused sets that mix house, Latin/world percussion, disco edits, and vintage vinyl textures. He played the Lounge at Rivera stage (12:00-12:45pm slot) at Ploverfest, a community music festival on San Francisco's Sunset Dunes, in April 2026.

Dom Dolla (Dominic Louis Matheson, b. January 18, 1992 in Manila) is an Australian tech house producer from Melbourne, raised in Darwin, who has released via Onelove, Sweat It Out, and now Three Six Zero Recordings/Sony Music. In December 2025 he became the first electronic act to headline an Australian stadium show, playing to 40,000 at Sydney's Allianz Stadium.
notable_releases: "The Boxer" (2013), "San Frandisco" (2019), "Moving Blind" with Sonny Fodera (2020), "Miracle Maker" ft. Clementine Douglas (2022), "Rhyme Dust" with MK (2023), "Eat Your Man" with Nelly Furtado (2023), "Girls" (2024), "Dreamin'" ft. Daya (2025)
labels: Onelove (2013–2015), Sweat It Out (2015–2021), Three Six Zero Recordings/Sony Music (2022–present)
notable_collaborations: Nelly Furtado, Gorillaz, Tame Impala, Tove Lo, Kid Cudi, MK, Sonny Fodera

bio: Lana with a K is a DJ tied to San Francisco's queer nightlife scene, having played b2b at El Rio's 'Disco Honey' parties alongside DJ Kinki and Ahuff. She played a b2b set with DJKinki at Camp Beaverton during Burning Man 2024.
burning_man_history: Played a b2b set with DJKinki ("Heavy Naturals") at Camp Beaverton, Burning Man 2024, released on SoundCloud.

bio: DJ Kalypso is a Los Angeles-based DJ, singer, and emcee, classically trained as a composer and electronic musician, with over 5 years performing at high-end events. Her artist bio lists past performances including Insomniac Events, Miami Music Week, LA afterparties, art shows, and Burning Man.
burning_man_history: Self-reported in her GigSalad artist bio as a past performance venue/event (no specific year, camp, or set given).

bio: DJ Spacecamp (Dan White) is a San Francisco-based DJ and the managing editor of DJ TechTools, DJing professionally since 2006 and serving as a resident DJ for SF party series Zero Fucks. His DJ name comes from being a five-time graduate of the Advanced Space Academy program at Space Camp in Huntsville, Alabama. No independent information on b2b partner "Freddie" was found.

Jalaya is a Denver-based bass music producer known for gritty, glitch-inflected basslines and dark, spiritually-themed production. She has remixed Modest Mouse ("Float On"), Rage Against the Machine ("Born of a Broken Man"), The Smashing Pumpkins ("Zero"), and System of a Down ("Prison Song"), and collaborated with Flesh Interface, Madi Gill, and Isabelle Rose.
notable_releases: Venom (album), Disguise EP, The Cobra EP, Heart Tear Remix EP, Resurrection – Remixes (album)
notable_collaborations: Flesh Interface, Madi Gill, Isabelle Rose
